test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Pace
solution:
The correct answer is **'Speed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the **given word** and the **marked option**:

 
 
• **Pace: **consistent and continuous speed in walking, running or moving.

 
 
• **Example*:**** Many people were not satisfied with the** pace** of change.*
 
 
 
• **Speed: **the rate at which someone or something is able to move or operate.
 
 
• **Example:*** He drove off at high **speed. ***
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus from above, we can say that the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Target: **a person, object, or place selected as the aim of an attack.
 
• **Corner: **a place or angle where two or more sides or edges meet.
 
• **Angle: **the space (usually measured in degrees) between two intersecting lines or surfaces at or close to the point where they meet.
